Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Trace Al/F co-doping during spent LiFePO4 regeneration tailors Li–Fe antisite defects, lowering charge-transfer resistance and boosting Li+ diffusion. item.title: Dynamic‐Coupling Axial Chloride on Dual‐Heteroatom Sites for Highly Anti‐Chloride Oxygen Reduction in Seawater
item.description:

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers a dynamic axial Cl coordination strategy using O-bridged FeMn dual-heteroatom catalysts to overcome chloride poisoning in seawater ORR. The Cl−FeN3−O1−MnN3 structure enables fast four-electron kinetics and suppresses Fe corrosion, achieving 0.941 V half-wave potential and 30,000-cycle stability. The approach is generalizable to Co, Ni, and Cu systems, advancing sustainable seawater energy conversion.
🏷 seawater ORR · dual-heteroatom catalysts · axial chloride · Zn-air battery · anti-chloride poisoning
